text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense a discomfort hanging in the air between Trainer Kiryuin and Happy Meek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a fellow trainer aiming for the same crown, I can't just sit and watch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I help them to reconcile, I get the sense that I'm witnessing the growth of my own rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Out of gratitude, Trainer Kiryuin gives me the Trainer's Handbook, a treatise containing the ultimate secrets of Umamusume training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the secret knowledge contained in the Kiryuin family's Trainer Handbook, <chrname> improves by leaps and bounds!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
